title: Matrix multiplication over F₂: improve the 4×4 rank bound
description: Sunstead specializes the upstream tensor-rank predicate to upper bounds for 4×4 matrix multiplication over F₂. This hill-climb is a Sunstead challenge. The public baseline uses 47 rank-one terms. A smaller verified table certifies a new upper bound for this mission.

tasks.title: Reduce the number of binary products
tasks.description: Submit your coefficient triples in Rank444/Certificate.lean. The frozen proof checks every coefficient and the kernel computes the table length. Only strict improvements earn credit.
